description:
C1PRO have rear suspension, more comfortable for ride.

LCD display control easy to know speed and battery status.

Bigger battery ride longer

Rear cargo basket, Headlight, Large footrest area

Pre-assembled: The electric scooter already comes pre-assembled so you won't have to waste time with complicated assembly and foreign scooter parts

Foldable: This e-scooter is easy to fold and save more space for storage. It weighs a mere 40lbs, easy to carry with one hand. Provided with Both good anti-pressure ability and lightweight frame. All this makes it a perfect

Go Further: 18-20 MILE RANGE. This electric scooter powered by 36V 8Ah battery, with a range of 18mils means your e-scooter commute just easier.

Go Faster: This electric scooter powered with 350-watt high speed motor can achieve top speed of 15mph

Button Horn – Replaces the traditional bell with a stylish push-button horn.

Key Ignition – Provides added security when parked, preventing theft
